verdict.rationale: Evidence covers only a slice of this story: a community build runs four RTX PRO 6000 cards in one system for high-throughput serving, MIG partitions one card into up to four isolated instances, and the documented host link is PCIe Gen 5. However, NVIDIA positions the card as a desktop/workstation part that works 'without relying on costly cloud or data center resources'. A hands-on user also notes SM120 lacks tcgen05 and main-library support compared with datacenter Blackwell (B300). Missing for 10: any documented high-bandwidth GPU-to-GPU interconnect such as NVLink, rack-scale or datacenter deployment documentation, first-party multi-GPU scaling guidance, and evidence of datacenter-scale training.
